reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding*

*P1 — Overlapping imports aren’t deduplicated by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`Set` compares objects by reference, so distinct objects with the same `id` both survive. `mergeImports` calls this directly (`src/merge.js:4`), violating the documented first-seen-wins behavior.

*Verified:* merging `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada'}]` with `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada updated'}]` returns both contacts instead of only the first.

*Recommended fix:* track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add regression tests for distinct objects sharing an ID, both in `dedupe` and across separate lists in `mergeImports`.

All 4 existing tests pass, but `test/dedupe.test.js` only checks repeated references and distinct IDs; neither catches this failure.

Reviewed the full diff against `main`. No files changed.
